title: Refusing to Exaggerate a Story
paragraphs: While retelling an incident at work to friends, Latifa noticed she was tempted to exaggerate certain details, since a slightly bigger version of the story clearly made everyone laugh harder.

She caught herself mid-sentence and corrected the detail honestly, admitting the actual event had been less dramatic than she was making it sound, even though the exaggeration would have gone unnoticed.
One friend, laughing, told her that most people would have kept the exaggerated version, and Latifa admitted the temptation had been real, but not worth compromising accuracy for a bigger laugh.
Reflecting later, Latifa realized that being truthful even in casual storytelling mattered, since small habitual exaggerations could slowly erode a person's overall reliability with others.
